clips.title: The story
paras: Rascally Rodents is a quest in Northshire Valley where Brother Paxton tasks adventurers with recovering stolen books from the local kobolds. Though Paxton initially fears the vermin are devouring his library, retrieving the texts reveals an unsettling mystery behind the creatures' motives.

Brother Paxton in Northshire Valley is in distress over the local kobold infestation, which has spilled over from the surrounding hills and mines into the sacred grounds. Convinced that the ravenous creatures have begun devouring the texts from his collection, he enlists the aid of young adventurers to hunt down the vermin and salvage whatever volumes remain before the entire library is lost.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Those awful kobolds are eating my books! You have to get them back before they devour my whole library.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you rescued my books yet, friend?!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you so much! Here! Take one of these how-to books. I don't need them.
But there are still so many books missing. The kobolds don't seem to be eating them. So, why do they want them?
